podcast.body: Released in 1994, this song resulted in a lawsuit from Monty Python, who claimed it sounded too much like "How Sweet to Be an Idiot," a song from a 1973 sketch. Neil Innes, the Python song's writer, was ultimately awarded a co-writing credit on Oasis's "Whatever." "They insisted that the 1994 song, Whatever, sounded way too much like a song from a 1973 sketch called How Sweet to Be an Idiot."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
